answer: Set Glazier pane proof lodged with the glaziers register at the gate and the farm's arithmetic collapses: 4-year apprenticeship, 147 supervised panes, guild exam, 48 POA annual fee, renewal. One failed proof among 579 burns 98 POA and exposes the cluster, so the farm risks 56742 POA on every epoch. Put the lantern on the table, put the mesa next to it, and put the jade underneath: the pile is the proof. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
